scope: Source complexity/resource review of the new RwClumpReader increment only. Model-record generated members, existing reader implementations, synthetic/retail tests, normalized adaptation, rendering, and production dispatch are outside callable review scope.

hashConvention.source: SHA-256 of UTF-8 source bytes after CRLF/CR to LF normalization; no trimming.
hashConvention.declaration: For named methods and lambdas: exact Tree-sitter declaration/expression byte span, including body and excluding preceding comments and following whitespace.
hashConvention.signature: Bytes from declaration start to body start, with trailing whitespace removed; expression-bodied method signature excludes the arrow-expression body.
hashConvention.body: Exact body node bytes, including block braces or the arrow-expression node for expression-bodied methods.
hashConvention.primaryConstructor: Declaration/signature hash covers the Reader class header through its primary-constructor parameter list, excluding the class body. The authored diagnostic field initializer declaration has a separate hash.

verification.method: Tree-sitter C# callable-span extraction, manual source review, JSON/hash/coverage checks and git diff --check. No compiler, test runner, GUI, benchmark or performance measurement was invoked for this artifact.
verification.grammarNotes: The installed grammar marks the empty collection initializer with a zero-width identifier diagnostic. Method/lambda declaration spans were inspected and are complete; no compilation claim is inferred from parsing.

variables.B: Input CLUMP byte length; after the root check the reader owns exactly one B-byte copy.
variables.H/h: Total visited chunk headers / direct children of one container; fixed-depth, constant-repeat structural scans count each header O(1) times.
variables.V/U/L: Total vertices / stored UV vector values across sets / decoded texture-name and mask-name bytes.
variables.T/I/S: Total serialized geometry triangles / BinMesh indices / BinMesh splits.
variables.P: Plugin count in the indicated scope; P <= H.
variables.g/m/x/a: Subscript narrows a quantity to one geometry/material/texture/atomic.
variables.D_g: Candidate BinMesh triangles in one geometry; at most I_g for strips and I_g/3 for lists.
variables.K_a/K_d/K: Distinct nondegenerate authored / drawn / current dictionary keys.
variables.K in Only: Number of allowed child types supplied through params; at most three at current call sites.

aggregateBounds.timeExpectedAmortized: O(B + H + F + G + A + M + V + U + T + I + L), hence O(B) for the admitted serialized layout and fixed-width records.
aggregateBounds.timeDictionaryWorstCase: O(B + H + F + G + A + M + V + U + I + L + sum_g((T_g + D_g)^2)); ordinary Dictionary value-tuple hashing is not a worst-case constant-time guarantee.
aggregateBounds.ownedOutput: O(B + H + F + G + A + M + V + U + T + I + L), including the single source copy, decoded arrays/strings, graph records, opaque-slice records and diagnostics.
aggregateBounds.additionalTransientStorage: Direct-child/filter arrays are O(H); frame traversal state is O(F); each topology check uses O(T_g + D_g) dictionary capacity. Only one geometry is checked at a time. Runtime GC may retain unreachable prior scratch until collection; aggregate allocation remains O(input).
aggregateBounds.callDepth: Fixed structural parser call depth; frame ancestry is iterative and opaque plugins are not recursively decoded.
aggregateBounds.resourcePolicy: Bounds are proportional to input, not an arbitrary acceptance cap. No identified count-driven allocation beyond serialized byte bounds. No cancellation token, decode quota, or benchmark-derived memory ceiling is provided by this pure reader.

resourceReview: Root type, bounded declared size, and exact end are checked before ToArray; an invalid outer container avoids the source copy.
Frame count and material-map count use Int64 exact-size equations before casts/allocations. Geometry count is compared with observed bounded chunks.
Existing RwGeometry and RwBinMesh decoders own their arrays and validate predicted/remaining payload sizes before their count-based allocations.

The row-vector frame matrices, flags, material reuse map and occurrence indices are retained. No scene normalization, coordinate conversion, UV changes, normal normalization or skin evaluation is performed.
Opaque chunk payloads and complete camera/light chunks are ReadOnlyMemory slices of the private source; creating wrappers does not copy plugin bodies.
The parent cycle walk uses one byte per frame and traverses each active edge a constant number of times; forward references do not require recursive stacks.
Topology keys preserve cyclic winding, material identity and multiplicity. Repeated-index degenerates remain in the source arrays and are excluded only from the redundant topology comparison.
Single allocates all matching child headers before checking uniqueness; malformed duplicate children can increase temporary allocations only in proportion to the actual input headers.
Error strings with offsets, type words, and source ordinals have bounded machine-integer lengths. Runtime exception/stack behavior is excluded from deterministic managed-algorithm claims.

followUps.detail: The existing 0x1300 header correction uses Math.Max(0, declaredSize - 8), so declared sizes below eight are accepted as empty bodies when surrounding chunks tile. This review records that inherited permissiveness; it neither changes the reader nor claims those short declarations are valid RenderWare payloads. Decide and test the malformed-header policy separately.

limitations: Asymptotic source review only; no measured throughput, latency, peak-memory or rendering-performance claim.
No independent test execution, compiler validation, platform acceptance, release acceptance or dispatch replacement is established by this artifact.
Successful structural decoding retains explicit diagnostics for unsupported plugin/skin/HAnim/camera/light semantics; it is not normalized-scene or visual-fidelity acceptance.
Record model files and independent retail-oracle assertions are reviewed elsewhere; this artifact binds only the reader callables and their stated external parser assumptions.

externalParserSources.role: Existing constant-time bounded header parser; its inherited 0x1300 correction is unchanged.
Existing generic geometry decoder verifies predicted Int64 byte size before array allocation; the new reader restricts morph count to one.
Existing decoder bounds split headers and index arrays by remaining payload bytes before allocation.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.TryRead
callables.timeBound: O(1) for an invalid outer header; otherwise O(B + H + F + V + U + T + I + M + A + L) expected/amortized
callables.spaceBound: O(B + H + F + V + U + T + I + M + A + L) owned output and transient storage
callables.review: Checks the complete root before allocation, then takes exactly one private source copy and delegates. Copies/decoding are O(input); dictionary worst cases are described in the aggregate policy. InvalidDataException is converted to an error; memory exhaustion and unrelated runtime failures are not swallowed.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.Reader(byte[] data)
callables.spaceBound: O(1); captures the already owned source reference and initializes one empty diagnostic list
callables.review: The compiler-generated primary-constructor body does not copy data. The explicit field initializer is hashed separately; nested method declarations are not part of this constructor hash.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.Read
callables.timeBound: O(H + F + V + U + T + I + M + A + L) expected/amortized
callables.spaceBound: O(H + F + V + U + T + I + M + A + L), excluding the already owned B-byte source
callables.review: Each top-level child is consumed once; a frame-association Struct consumes its adjacent camera/light. A constant number of filtered scans does not create nested all-pairs work. Child decoders and topology validation dominate.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.Read.lambda1
callables.review: Fixed-size property/index comparison; enclosing LINQ traversal and delegate capture are accounted for at the owning method.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.Read.lambda2
callables.review: Fixed-size property/index comparison; enclosing LINQ traversal and delegate capture are accounted for at the owning method.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.ReadFrames
callables.spaceBound: O(h + F + P) output/transient records; O(F) explicit traversal state
callables.review: Exact 4 + 56*count size uses Int64 before the frame-array allocation. Frame-parent range is checked before traversal. The three-color iterative walk transitions each frame from unvisited to active to complete once; forward references do not add quadratic ancestry work. P is the plugins in these frames.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.ReadFrames.lambda1
callables.review: Fixed-size property/index comparison; enclosing LINQ traversal and delegate capture are accounted for at the owning method.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.ReadGeometries
callables.timeBound: O(h + G + V + U + T + I + M + L + P) expected/amortized
callables.spaceBound: O(h + G + V + U + T + I + M + L + P) output, plus O(max_g(T_g + D_g)) topology scratch
callables.review: Declared geometry count must equal observed geometry chunks. Each geometry is decoded once; the existing parsers bound arrays by serialized sizes. One geometry's triangle dictionaries are used at a time; managed reclamation timing is runtime-owned.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.ReadGeometries.lambda1
callables.review: Fixed-size property/index comparison; enclosing LINQ traversal and delegate capture are accounted for at the owning method.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.ValidateGeometryValues
callables.review: Reads the first morph presence flags and sphere, then visits all positions, optional normals, and UV values. Earlier exact geometry-size validation bounds offset arithmetic. No normalization or array copy occurs.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.ReadMaterials
callables.spaceBound: O(h + M_g + L_g + P_g) owned output/transient records
callables.review: Material-map length is checked with Int64 before allocation. Every reuse index references an earlier slot and copies a reference in O(1), without following an alias chain. Newly authored material chunks are decoded once.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.ReadMaterials.lambda1
callables.review: Fixed-size property/index comparison; enclosing LINQ traversal and delegate capture are accounted for at the owning method.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.ReadMaterial
callables.review: Constant-sized structure and texture-presence checks precede optional texture decoding. Texture strings and opaque plugin records dominate variable cost; float values are retained and checked for finiteness.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.ReadMaterial.lambda1
callables.review: Fixed-size property/index comparison; enclosing LINQ traversal and delegate capture are accounted for at the owning method.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.ReadTexture
callables.review: Requires exactly two string chunks; sampler is retained without reinterpretation. String decode and extension enumeration are linear in their source domains.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.ReadTexture.lambda1
callables.review: Fixed-size property/index comparison; enclosing LINQ traversal and delegate capture are accounted for at the owning method.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.ReadString
callables.review: NUL search is bounded by the chunk payload. Latin-1 decoding copies only the prefix and retains each source byte value. A missing terminator declines rather than reading the next chunk.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.ReadAtomic
callables.review: The 16-byte core is constant; frame and geometry references are range checked. Plugin records retain borrowed slices into the private source copy.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.Extensions
callables.spaceBound: O(P) chunk headers, opaque records, list storage and diagnostics
callables.review: Only plugin headers are walked. Payloads are not recursively decoded or copied; each plugin gets one opaque record, and each undecoded type gets one diagnostic. Scope strings are passed by reference; integer scope labels are fixed-width machine values.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.Opaque
callables.review: AsMemory retains a bounded slice of the Reader-owned source array together with type, library id and source-relative header offset.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.Children
callables.review: Every successful chunk consumes its 12-byte header plus nonnegative corrected payload. Parent bounds are checked by RwChunk.TryRead; the walk progresses even for empty bodies and does not recursively scan opaque bytes. List growth is amortized.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.Body
callables.review: Checks optional exact structure size and returns a span over owned data. The formatted offset diagnostic has bounded machine-integer length; no payload copy.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.Single
callables.spaceBound: O(k), k matching headers and k <= h
callables.review: The filtered ToArray scans direct children and may allocate for every duplicate before rejecting. This remains input-proportional; it is not a count-controlled allocation.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.Single.lambda1
callables.review: Fixed-size property/index comparison; enclosing LINQ traversal and delegate capture are accounted for at the owning method.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.Only
callables.timeBound: O(h*K), O(h) at existing call sites where K <= 3
callables.spaceBound: O(1) inside the predicate/enumerator, plus O(K) caller params storage
callables.review: Each direct child is checked against a small allowed-type array. Short-circuits on the first unsupported type.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.Only.lambda1
callables.timeBound: O(K); K <= 3 at current call sites
callables.review: Checks one child type against the allowed-type array; included in Only bounds.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.ValidateTopology
callables.timeBound: O(S_g + T_g + I_g + D_g) expected/amortized; O(S_g + I_g + (T_g + D_g)^2) collision worst case
callables.spaceBound: O(K_a + K_d), bounded by O(T_g + D_g)
callables.review: Checks all source references before accumulating orientation/material/multiplicity keys. Each strip index participates in O(1) candidate triangles; D_g <= I_g. Repeated-index degenerate faces are ignored only for correspondence, while both original arrays remain unchanged. Separate authored/drawn dictionaries use ordinary value-tuple hashing.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.ValidateTopology.lambda1
callables.review: Fixed-size property/index comparison; enclosing LINQ traversal and delegate capture are accounted for at the owning method.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.ValidateTopology.lambda2
callables.timeBound: O(1) expected/amortized; O(K_d) worst-case dictionary collision chain
callables.review: One fixed-size key lookup in the drawn-triangle dictionary; included in ValidateTopology bounds.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.AddTriangle
callables.timeBound: O(1) expected/amortized; O(K) for a collision-chain lookup or resizing at K keys
callables.spaceBound: O(1) amortized retained entry growth; O(K) transient capacity replacement on resize
callables.review: Three integer comparisons/rotations canonicalize cyclic order without reversing winding. Repeated-index degenerates return immediately. Key hashing/comparison is fixed-size; Dictionary complexity is not asserted as deterministic O(1).

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.U32
callables.review: Reads one little-endian word from a previously bounded structure.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.I32
callables.review: Reads one signed little-endian word from a previously bounded structure.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.Finite
callables.review: One floating-point finiteness test.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.F32
callables.review: Reads one little-endian float and rejects nonfinite values; does not alter finite source bits.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.Invalid
callables.spaceBound: O(1) exception object; borrows message string
callables.review: Does not parse or copy input. Runtime exception construction/stack handling is not a measured performance claim.

callables.name: RwClumpReader.Reader.Require
callables.timeBound: O(1) excluding runtime throw/stack handling on failure
callables.spaceBound: O(1) on success; exception allocation on failure
callables.review: Returns for a true condition, otherwise throws the reader's InvalidDataException. Callers may already have allocated diagnostic text, accounted for at their call sites.
